Definition: Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occupied by him
BiblicalUsage: Edom = "red"; 1) Edom; 2) Edomite, Idumean-descendants of Esau; 3) land of Edom, Idumea-land south and south east of Palestine
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
